claim.claim-text: 1. An apparatus (1100) for obtaining at least one portion of a biological tissue, the apparatus comprising:
2. The apparatus (1100) of claim 1, further comprising a substrate (1030) for placement at a donor site.
3. The apparatus (1100) of claim 2, wherein each tube of the plurality of tubes (1010) is slideably attached to the substrate (1030).

4. The apparatus (1100) of claim 2, wherein each tube of the plurality of tubes (1010) is slidably attached to the substrate (1030) such that each tube of the plurality of tubes (1010) passes through a corresponding hole of a plurality of holes (1310) provided in the substrate (1010).

5. The apparatus (1100) of claim 2, wherein the substrate (1030) includes one or more holes (1310); and wherein each tube of the plurality of tubes (1010) is configured to pass through the one or more holes (1030) of the substrate (1030).

6. The apparatus (1100) of claim 5, wherein each tube of the plurality of tubes (1010) is configured to pass through the one or more holes (1030) of the substrate (1030) to sever and extract the corresponding portion of the biological tissue.
7. The apparatus (1100) of claim 2, further comprising a positioning arrangement configured to control a position of each tube of the plurality of tubes (1010) relative to the substrate.
8. The apparatus (1100) of claim 1, further comprising one or more actuators (1120) configured to translate the plurality of tubes (1010).
9. The apparatus (1100) of claim 1, wherein an inner diameter of each tube of the plurality of tubes (1010) is 1 mm or less.
10. The apparatus (1100) of claim 1, further comprising at least one sensor configured to detect a presence of the portion of biological tissue within at least one of the plurality of tubes (1010).
11. The apparatus (1100) of claim 1, further comprising an array of hollow tubes that includes the plurality of tubes (1040).

12. The apparatus (1100) of claim 1, wherein each pin of the plurality of pins (1040) is configured to deposit the corresponding portion of the biological tissue directly into a biocompatible matrix or a recipient site.
13. The apparatus (1100) of claim 1, wherein a surface of each pin of the plurality of pins (1040) comprises a low-friction material.

14. The apparatus (1100) of claim 1, wherein at least one section of each tube of the plurality of tubes (1010) is structured to be inserted into the biological tissue at the donor site to remove the corresponding portion of the biological tissue therefrom and retain the corresponding portion of the biological tissue within the tube when the at least one section of each tube of the plurality of tubes (1010) is withdrawn from the donor site.
15. The apparatus (1100) of claim 1, wherein each pin of the plurality of pins (1040) is translatable along a longitudinal axis of the respective tube of the plurality of tubes (1040).
